name: Research Access
summary: The library opens its doors to you for study. Your actions have shown respect for knowledge.

sections.title: Library Access
sections.body: You have earned access to the library for your studies. Its doors are open to you.

faq.q: Why can I enter the library?
faq.answer: Your actions have shown respect for knowledge, and the library is open to you for study.

faq.q: What does the library offer me?
faq.answer: The library is open for your study.
Your actions showed respect for knowledge.
